## How it works

<h2>Explore the surveyed bridge</h2>
    <p>The 92 MB LAZ opens at the Golden Gate using its embedded WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator coordinates (EPSG:3857). Elevations are in NAVD88 metres (EPSG:5703). Zoom toward either tower to see the scan refine. Use <strong>View → Layers</strong> to switch the basemap.</p>
    <p>The cloud contains 21,854,294 returns in a 90 m wide corridor along the main span and approaches. Allow about 2.2 GB of temporary browser storage for indexing. Each return includes position, laser intensity and classification.</p>

<h2>Survey source and reuse</h2>
    <p><a href="https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/inport/item/73386/full-list">2023 USGS Lidar: San Francisco, CA</a> was acquired by NV5 Geospatial for the USGS 3D Elevation Program. Flinker clipped all survey detail levels to the bridge corridor, retaining the point attributes and coordinates, and ordered the points by acquisition time for lossless LAZ compression. The survey is <a href="https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program/about-3dep-products-services">public domain</a>.</p>
